content: हेवाकः Ardent or intense desire, eagerness; (this word, like the word लटभ <ab>q. v.</ab>, is used only by later writers like Kalhaṇa, Bilhaṇa, and is probably derived from <lang>Persian</lang> or <lang>Arabic</lang>, <ab>cf.</ab> <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>हेवा</ns>); अस्मिन्नासीत्तदनु निबिडाश्लेषहेवाकलीलविल्लद्बाहुक्वणितबलया संततं राजलक्ष्मीः <ls>Vikr. 18. 101</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> हेवाकिन् below.
